method.route: Gauss-Legendre integration of mass-weighted H parallel/perpendicular projections over ln(m_H)
method.q_mesh: full even midpoint grids, reciprocal-vector density, no Gamma, uniform weights
method.convergence: two consecutive distinct refinements per structure, componentwise half pair tolerance
method.imaginary_policy: same sorted-band mask f_H>1e-7 and f_D>1e-7 THz at every mass; exclude all other modes
method.stretch: unit vector from H to nearest periodic non-H atom, fixed relaxed geometry
method.normalization: primitive atom count, each structure separately

comparison.sign_policy: strict sign, including zero; no tolerance relabeling

selection.policy: ascending combined atom count within each model; alternate mace/orb
